summary: Full backend + frontend testing of News Summarizer completed. 13/14 pytest backend tests passed (1 flake from parallel-load timeout; endpoint verified working via curl). 32/32 frontend behaviours verified after correcting for two Playwright-env artefacts. All core flows work end-to-end with real Claude Sonnet 4.5 + real Tavily calls: URL validation, structured 9-section summary, cache hits (including UTM/case-insensitive normalization), sliding-hour rate limits on both /api/summarize and /api/latest-updates, latest-updates ordering & dedupe, error state, theme toggle, footer socials/copyright, all export buttons (copy/pdf/docx/share), Latest Updates via Tavily.

minor.issue: Test timed out at 15s only while another pytest worker was mid-Claude-call (parallel load). Curl confirms endpoint returns 200 in ~230ms. Not a code bug — consider a slightly higher default timeout or scoping serverload tests to a single worker.

action_items: No production fixes required. All 8 backend behaviours + 12 frontend behaviours in the request are working.
OPTIONAL: If flake on /api/health under parallel load bothers you, bump the client timeout in tests or add a startup warm-up. Not user-facing.
critical_code_review_comments: services.py extract_article() double-fetches on the fallback path (trafilatura.fetch_url then requests.get) — consider a single requests-with-browser-UA pass to save time and one round-trip.

server.py summarize() charges rate limit BEFORE running extraction — user gets penalised for an extraction 422 (e.g. paywalled article). Consider only charging rate limit on successful AI call, or refunding on 422/502.

services.py fetch_latest_updates: exclude_url comparison uses full normalized URL; if Tavily returns the same article via a slightly different slug (e.g. /amp), it will slip past the exclude filter. Minor.
Home.jsx duplicate submission guarded via inFlight ref — good — but the Hero URL input remains editable during loading which is fine visually; consider blurring the input on submit for polish.
CacheAndRateLimit stores created_at as ISO string then re-parses on read — cheaper to store native datetime (motor handles bson dates).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (32/32 after granting clipboard permission for headless retest)

test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Reset db.rate_limit + db.summary_cache before session via conftest.py fixture. One cached SpaceX summary retained mid-test for frontend fast path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate-limit and cache tests share Mongo state — conftest.py autouse session fixture handles the reset. All tests live in a single module so pytest-xdist --dist loadscope pins them to one worker for deterministic order. When retesting the frontend, note that Playwright headless Chromium blocks navigator.clipboard.writeText by default — use page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'], origin=...) to verify the btn-copy toast. Loading state may skip in Playwright if the URL is already cached in Mongo — either delete the cache row first or submit a new URL to see /data-testid='loading-state'/.
